moments.text: Handheld recording of an infrared screen: grainy grey background, broken crosshair left of picture centre, a small dark spot boxed at its centre.
The box opens into empty corner brackets and the spot is no longer visible; the brackets vanish at 5.3 s.
A dark spot shows left of the crosshair, slides close to the left edge, then the view pans and brings it back toward the crosshair.
A small white x marker appears beside the spot, and the spot settles just right of the crosshair centre.
The view zooms in: the spot becomes a larger round dark blob right of the crosshair, swings left past its centre and back.
A tracking box appears beside the blob and slides onto it.
The view zooms back out and the picture blurs briefly as the recording tilts.
The box holds the dark spot at the crosshair centre for the rest of the video while the grainy background drifts.

notes: Full-frame recheck: crosshair sits left of picture centre; positions now relative to it.
